title: Gate opens
desc: [City] Gate opens 12:01 am Sunday, then 24 hours a day. There is NO departure gate closure - leave any time; event ends Mon 6 pm, Exodus support to 11:59 pm Tue. Earlier arrival needs a Setup Access Pass.

title: Man Burn
desc: [City] The Man burns Saturday night after dark. Exact time unpublished; respect the perimeter.

title: Temple Burn
desc: [City] The Temple burns Sunday night after dark, in silence. Exact time unpublished.

title: Burn Gardens open
desc: [City] Public burn platforms open Sun 10 am through Tue. Wood only; never burn on the playa.

title: Box Office closes
desc: [City] Last ticket/credential/Will Call pickup: noon Monday.

title: Event officially ends
desc: [City] Ends 6 pm Monday. Exodus continues after; you need not be gone by 6.

title: Exodus support ends
desc: [City] Exodus support through 11:59 pm Tuesday. K Street to 6:00, then Gate Road; GARS 95.1 FM.
